title: Schachtel's Bakery
alt: A painted family scene outside Schachtel's Bakery at night
caption: Family history painting
story: The painting gathers a family enterprise and several generations into one remembered place.||Ina developed the scene from family accounts and archival reference rather than treating the source photographs as a fixed composition.

title: Schachtel Family Dinner
alt: A large painted family gathering around a dinner table
caption: Commissioned group portrait
story: The work was shaped through family interviews and period research. Clothing, hairstyles, gestures, and the distances between figures help describe how the family related to one another.
